scope: Only exact package/version/advisory records with owner, reason, evidence and non-expired review are accepted. Empty means no exceptions.

dispositions.reason: The upstream fix is confined to KAPT incremental-cache deserialization. This project applies no KAPT plugin, tasks, configurations or annotation processors. Gradle verifyNoKapt and the build-advisory source guard fail if that condition changes. This is not a declaration that the Kotlin package itself is patched.
